acceptance_criteria.criterion: A path whose inferred project root cannot be determined returns 'unknown'
The returned value is lowercased and passes safe-slug validation (alphanumeric + hyphens only)
The function is exported and importable by ledger-store.ts and other callers without circular dependency

summary: Added `deriveRepoName(projectPath: string): string` to `mcp-server/src/utils/ledger-root.ts`. The function walks 4 levels up via `inferProjectRootFromPlanPath`, lowercases the basename, validates against `SAFE_SLUG_REGEX`, and returns `'unknown'` on any failure.
Added `SAFE_SLUG_REGEX` import from `./constants.js` to `ledger-root.ts` — no circular dependency (constants.ts does not import ledger-root).

Created `mcp-server/tests/utils/derive-repo-name.test.ts` with 10 unit tests covering: standard path, uppercase normalisation, Windows backslash paths, mixed-separator Windows paths, too-shallow paths, empty string, underscores, spaces, numeric-only name, and alternate repo name.
Full test suite: 75 files / 2236 tests — all pass. TypeScript type-check: no errors.

comments.note: ledger-root.ts: `SAFE_SLUG_REGEX` is now imported from constants.ts, making it the single authoritative pattern for slug validation across the storage layer. No duplication risk going forward.
No other issues observed — the touched files are clean, consistent, and follow established conventions.
